label: 角色预览
description: 把 RigSpec（来自 g_to_rig）推送到内嵌 3D 预览器进行角色可视化。前端 live-sync 拉取本节点 rigSpec 输出，命中即切 character 模式（加载 <sha>.glb + 测地体素绑定求权重 → SkinnedMesh + Skeleton + 播放骨骼 clip）。rigSpec 端口透传，便于继续接线。
description-en: Forward a RigSpec (from g_to_rig) to the embedded 3D viewer for character preview. The frontend live-sync pulls this node's rigSpec output and switches to character mode (load <sha>.glb + geodesic voxel binding → SkinnedMesh + Skeleton + play bone clips). Pass-through for chaining.
